headline: Approved filling two open jobs and four applications, and certified Fire Marshal List #26-26.
summary: Commissioners approved minutes from two earlier meetings. They also approved three internal Fire Marshal applications and one Maintainer application, which were added to the agenda during the meeting. All votes were unanimous.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the October 20, 2026 regular meeting, unanimously.
Approved the minutes of the September 25, 2026 special meeting, unanimously.
Approved both Requests To Fill, for Information Technology Administrator and Library Page, unanimously.
Approved three internal applications for Fire Marshal, unanimously.

decision_evidence.quote: Commissioner Ward motioned to approve the October 20th, 2026 Regular Meeting minutes. Commissioner Andrews seconded the motion. Motion passes unanimously.
Commissioner Andrews motioned to approve the September 25th, 2026 Special Meeting minutes. Commissioner Ward seconded the motion. Motion passes unanimously.
Commissioner Andrews motioned to approve both Requests To Fill, for Information Technology Administrator and Library Page. Commissioner Ward seconded the motion. Motion passes unanimously.
Commissioner Ward motioned to approve the three (3) internal applications for Fire Marshal. Commissioner Andrews seconded the motion. Motion passes unanimously.
Commissioner Andrews motioned to approve one (1) Maintainer application. Commissioner Ward seconded the motion. Motion passes unanimously.
Commissioner Lobo motioned to certify List #26-26 Fire Marshal. Commissioner Ward seconded the motion. Motion passes unanimously.

TOWN OF HAMDEN, CONNECTICUT 
 
Civil Service Commission Minutes         
         
Regular Meeting 
 
9:00 AM, November 3, 2026 
 
 
 
Hamden Government 
Center 
2750 Dixwell Avenue 
Hamden, CT  06518 
Tel:  (203) 287-7070 
Fax:  (203) 287-7075 
 Click to View Agenda   
  
1. CALL TO ORDER 
  
 9 a.m.  
2. ATTENDANCE 
  
 Commissioners in attendance: Curt Andrews, Helen Ward and Andrea Lobo. 
Staff in attendance: J. Susy Diaz-Callands, Ken Kelley, Lee Palmer, Richard Campos 
and  Michael White. 
3. APPROVAL OF PREVIOUS MEETING MINUTES 
  
 
 
  1. Review and approval of the 10.20.2026 CSC Regular Meeting Minutes  
  
• Commissioner Ward motioned to approve the October 20th, 2026 Regular 
Meeting minutes. 
• Commissioner Andrews seconded the motion.  
• Motion passes unanimously.  
 
  2. Review and approval of the 9.25.2026 CSC Special Meeting Minutes  
  
• Commissioner Andrews motioned to approve the September 25th, 2026 Special 
Meeting minutes. 
• Commissioner Ward seconded the motion.  
• Motion passes unanimously.  
 
4. PUBLIC COMMENT 
  
 None. 
5. CORRESPONDENCE
None. 
6. ACTION ITEMS 
  
 
 
 1. RTF: 
1. Information Technology Administrator 
2. Library Page 
       
  
• Commissioner Andrews motioned to approve both Requests To Fill, for 
Information Technology Administrator and Library Page. 
• Commissioner Ward seconded the motion. 
• Motion passes unanimously.  
 
7. EXECUTIVE SESSION 
(if recommended by the town attorney)  
 None. 
8. REPORTS 
  
 None. 
 
 
9. OLD BUSINESS 
  
 
• Commissioner Lobo motioned to add to the agenda the approval of three (3) 
internal applications for Fire Marshal and one (1) more Maintainer application.  
• Commissioner Ward seconded the motion.  
• Motion passes unanimously.  
 
 
• Commissioner Ward motioned to approve the three (3) internal applications for Fire 
Marshal.  
• Commissioner Andrews seconded the motion.  
• Motion passes unanimously.  
 
 
• Commissioner Andrews motioned to approve one (1) Maintainer application. 
• Commissioner Ward seconded the motion.  
• Motion passes unanimously.
10. NEW BUSINESS 
  
 
• Commissioner Andrews motioned to add to the agenda List #26-26 Fire Marshal, 
for certification.  
• Commissioner Lobo seconded the motion.  
• Motion passes unanimously.  
 
 
• Commissioner Lobo motioned to certify List #26-26 Fire Marshal. 
• Commissioner Ward seconded the motion.  
• Motion passes unanimously.  
 
11. ADJOURNMENT 
  
 Commissioner Andrews motioned to adjourn. 
 
Commissioner Lobo seconded the motion. 
Motion passed unanimously, meeting adjourned at 9:07 a.m.
